headline: Self-expression is making your inner self visible—showing who you are through what you say, do, and create
universal_truth: Expression completes identity; who you are internally matters, but showing it connects you to the world
fun_facts: Self-expression has been shown to improve mental health and reduce stress
All cultures throughout history have valued some form of creative self-expression
Suppressed expression correlates with depression and anxiety
discussion_questions: How do you express who you are?
What parts of yourself do you hide versus show?
What would fuller self-expression look like for you?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: You have an inner world—thoughts, feelings, creativity. Self-expression is making that inner world visible. Through words, art, style, actions—you show who you are. Expression connects internal experience to external reality.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: We can hide or show ourselves. Why does expression matter? Why not just keep things inside?

options.text: Expression makes identity real and creates connection—unexpressed you stays isolated; showing who you are lets others know you, enables belonging, and completes the self
options.response: Yes. You can only connect through what you express. Hidden selves stay alone. Expression is the bridge between inner experience and outer relationship. It makes you findable by your people.
Art is one form, but expression happens through conversation, style, choices, work—everyone expresses...

q1.title: Forms of Expression
q1.script: Expression takes many forms: how you dress, what you create, what you say, how you work. Every choice that makes inner states visible is expression. You're already expressing—the question is how deliberately.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Forms of Expression"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Risk of Visibility
q2.script: Expression makes you visible—and therefore vulnerable. Someone might reject what you express. This risk is real but usually worth taking. Hidden is safe but lonely.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Authentic vs Performed
q3.script: Expression can be authentic or performed. Showing who you actually are differs from performing who you think you should be. Authentic expression connects; performance protects but isolates.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Expression completes identity. Who you are internally matters, but showing it connects you to the world. Express yourself.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 324. Tomorrow, we'll explore what makes you you—individuality. Until then, consider how fully you're expressing who you are.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Expression Inventory - What Are You Showing?
growTrack.activity: How do you currently express yourself—through what you create, say, wear, do? What parts of yourself remain unexpressed? What would more authentic or fuller expression look like? Try one new form of expression.
